title: RQG Item - hitLocation
description: Generated JSON Schema for the "hitLocation" Item DataModel's `system` data. Source: src/data-model/item-data/hit-location-data-model.ts. Do not edit by hand — run `pnpm generate:schemas`.

dieFrom.title: Roll from
dieFrom.description: Lowest D20 roll that hits this location.

dieTo.title: Roll to
dieTo.description: Highest D20 roll that hits this location.

hitPoints.title: Hit points
hitPoints.description: The location's hit points. On a character they are calculated from the character's total hit points and the wounds, never stored.

baseHpDelta.title: Hit point adjustment
baseHpDelta.description: Added to the location's hit points, for example +1 for a leg.

naturalAp.title: Natural armor points
naturalAp.description: Armor points the location has by itself, before worn armor.

wounds.title: Wounds
wounds.description: The damage of each open wound on the location.

hitLocationHealthState.title: Location health
hitLocationHealthState.description: Condition of the location: healthy, wounded, useless or severed.

actorHealthImpact.title: Impact on health
actorHealthImpact.description: The health state this location puts the character in: for example wounded, shock, unconscious or dead.

hitLocationType.title: Location type
hitLocationType.description: Kind of location: limb, head, chest or abdomen.

connectedTo.title: Connected to
connectedTo.description: Name of the location this one is attached to.

armorPoints.title: Armor points
armorPoints.description: Natural armor points plus what equipped armor adds. Calculated, never stored.
